import re

base_dir = "/home/catherine/documents/work/meetings/"
for file_path in files:
    # Extract filename from full path
    filename = file_path.split("/")[-1]
    # Split on "__" to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = filename.split("__")
    # Split rest on last "." to get file_name and extension
    file_name, extension = rest.rsplit(".", 1)
    # Construct destination path
    dest_path = base_dir + file_name + "/" + date_part + "." + extension
    # Move the file
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(
        access_token=access_token,
        source_file_path=file_path,
        destination_file_path=dest_path,
        overwrite=False,
        retain_dates=True
    )
    print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {dest_path}: {result}")
